channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Spider-Man Brand New Day leaks online: Millions watch Tom Holland film before X takes it down
item.description: A high-quality unauthorised copy of Spider-Man: Brand New Day briefly circulated on X, reaching millions of users before it was removed from the platform.&nbsp;

item.title: This Amazon-sold step stool has been recalled after multiple reports of falls and injuries
item.description: According to the recall notice issued on July 30, the affected tower stools can collapse or tip over while a child is using them.

item.title: Savannah Guthrie makes emotional plea as mother Nancy remains missing after six months: ‘Please bring her home’
item.description: Saturday marked six months since Nancy Guthrie disappeared on February 1. No arrests have been made, and investigators continue to pursue multiple leads while urging the public to come forward with any information.

item.title: Spider-Man Brand New Day Box Office Collection Day 3: Tom Holland film eyes a massive $470 million debut globally
item.description: Spider-Man: Brand New Day is tracking for a massive global opening, driven by strong overseas demand across major markets and a record-setting start in several territories.

item.title: Trump hails Gaza peace deal as ‘great breakthrough’, but Hamas and Israel disagree on key conditions
item.description: Speaking at Camp David, Trump said the agreement represented “a big step for the Middle East” and expressed confidence that it could help end months of fighting in Gaza, despite acknowledging that the process would face challenges.

item.title: ‘Who cares anymore?’ Hritik Roshan replies to apology post; social media hails Bollywood actor
item.description: Popular influencer Freddy Birdy’s Instagram post about Hrithik Roshan has gained attention, with nearly 40,000 likes. The Bollywood actor has responded to it.

item.title: Why did authorities raid The Exorcist star Linda Blair’s home? Here's the reason
item.description: Authorities inspected Linda Blair’s Southern California property as part of an investigation into the number and care of rescue dogs housed at the actress’s residence.

item.title: Ceuta crisis: Spain PM blasts ‘selfish’ reaction by some EU countries; calls for ministers to meet
item.description: Sanchez said the response of some European governments to the situation “is not only contrary to European law, humanitarian law, and the principles of solidarity that bind us together.”

item.title: Spider-Man Brand New Day characters explained: Meet Peter, MJ, Ned and the heroes shaping his new chapter
item.description: Spider-Man: Brand New Day follows a lonely Peter Parker as he navigates life after being forgotten, reconnects with familiar faces and finds support from unexpected allies.

item.title: Rahul Gandhi, Pappu Yadav, Awadhesh Prasad booked over Ram temple donation theft skit in Parliament
item.description: The FIR and complaints alleged that opposition leaders — Rahul Gandhi, Pappu Yadav, Awadhesh Prasad — mocked Sanatan culture under the garb of the protest.

item.title: Landlord asks for WiFi password: Hesitant tenant asks Reddit for advice, hilarious suggestions follow
item.description: A Reddit user faces an awkward situation when their landlord requests the Wi-Fi password for news access in exchange for a minor bill reduction.&nbsp;

item.title: 'You don't need a PhD': Nvidia's Jensen Huang says AI boom will create $100,000 jobs for electricians, plumbers
item.description: Jensen Huang says you don't need a PhD to earn six figures. Here's why AI's data centre boom is creating a shortage of electricians and tradespeople.

item.title: Abhijeet Dipke hopes PM Modi apologises in tonight's video — ‘…to all girls whom police beat with brutality’
item.description: Dipke said he hopes that PM Modi will post another video today to apologise for smashing the heads of young girls during the police brutality on July 20, and the alleged sexual harassment by police officers.

item.title: Mukesh Khanna warns Gen Z over CJP protest: ‘No police will help you’: Social media reacts
item.description: Mukesh Khanna criticised CJP members, likening them to cockroaches and warning young people about the consequences of their actions. CJP responded.

item.title: Top US General warns Pentagon he lacks enough naval forces to keep defending Israel from Iranian attacks: Report
item.description: The report comes amid growing concerns over the depletion of advanced US interceptor missiles following months of military operations in the Middle East.

item.title: Resume red flags: Ex-Google recruiter shares what gets you rejected instantly
item.description: According to a former Google recruiter, legacy hiring methods are completely obsolete. In a highly competitive job market, getting past the initial screening phase now requires absolute precision.

item.title: US water systems targeted in cyberattacks across seven states, FBI warns; Iranian hackers suspected
item.description: While authorities are examining possible Iranian involvement, they cautioned that the attacks have not been definitively attributed and the assessment could change as more technical evidence is collected.

item.title: Who is Leopold Aschenbrenner? ‘AI prophet’ gets married this weekend after losing $35 billion
item.description: Leopold Aschenbrenner gained attention after a viral essay on AI. A former OpenAI researcher, he faced dismissal over security concerns but later raised $225 million for his hedge fund.&nbsp;

item.title: Phoenix Extends Record-Breaking Heat as West Faces Fire Threat
item.description: Phoenix has had a record-breaking run of high temperatures and that streak will continue through the coming week, as heat and fire risks spread across the wider US West.

item.title: Trump considering attacks on Iran's energy infrastructure, report says
item.description: Speaking to reporters during a Cabinet meeting at the Camp David presidential retreat in Maryland on Friday, Trump signalled that US military operations against Iran were far from over.

item.title: US embassies warn ‘Americans should consider departing Middle East’ as tensions with Iran rise
item.description: In security alerts issued by US diplomatic missions in Amman, Jerusalem, Muscat, Baghdad and Beirut, Americans were advised to consider departing the region or be ready to do so if the security situation deteriorates further.

item.title: Check Joseph Tsai's net worth as Alibaba co-founder announces divorce with wife Clara Wu after 30 years of marriage
item.description: Clara and Joseph Tsai are ending their 30-year marriage amicably and respectfully. Both remain committed to their business roles and philanthropic work.&nbsp;

item.title: Why did migrants return to Morocco just hours after crossing into Ceuta?
item.description: One of the biggest reasons was that migrants could not continue their journey beyond Ceuta. Spanish authorities stressed that irregular entry into Ceuta does not grant the right to remain in Spain, travel to the mainland or move freely across the European Union.

item.title: Legendary mountaineer Nirmal ‘Nimsdai’ Purja declared dead in avalanche on PoK peak
item.description: Nirmal Purja climbed the world’s 14 highest peaks in a record 189 days in 2019, an achievement featured in the Netflix documentary, “14 Peaks: Nothing is Impossible.” His record was surpassed in 2023.

item.title: After Kangana, Pawan Kalyan praises PM Modi amid criticism, equates him to Lord Rama: ‘Think what we can do as Hanuman’
item.description: PM Narendra Modi inaugurated the Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport at Bhogapuram. He was joined by Palwan Kalyan, Chief Minister N Chandrababu Naidu, and Governor S Abdul Nazeer.

item.title: Nepal Border Violence: Why is Bihar Police on alert with surveillance and search operations? Explained
item.description: Security is heightened along the India-Nepal border in Bihar due to protests over Nepal's communal violence. Curfews were imposed in multiple districts following clashes in Sunsari.

item.title: Census 2027: Self-enumeration exercise begins in West Bengal from August 1 — How to apply? Is it compulsory?
item.description: Self-enumeration is simple and should not take more than 10 minutes, Calcutta’s principal census officer said, noting that it is not mandatory.

item.title: Petrol in Delhi would have cost around ₹125/litre without ethanol blending during crude spike, says Centre
item.description: Petrol in Delhi would have cost around ₹125 per litre when global crude prices hit $135 a barrel, had ethanol not been blended into fuel, the Centre said. Defending the E20 programme, it said consumers instead paid ₹94.77 per litre, calling ethanol India's energy insurance against oil shocks.

item.title: Maharashtra rain: Landslide blocks road in Nandurbar, Taloda-Dhadgaon route blocked; IMD issues red alert
item.description: Heavy rain continues to batter Maharashtra, triggering a landslide in Nandurbar, prompting school closures and raising flood concerns. IMD has issued a red alert for the district and warnings elsewhere.

item.title: Sam Altman's ChatGPT idea for parents backfires as internet asks: ‘Why not just talk to your kids?’
item.description: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman's suggestion to use ChatGPT to generate personalised podcasts for children during school drop-offs has triggered a wave of criticism online, with many users questioning why parents wouldn't simply talk to their kids instead.

item.title: PM Modi inaugurates ₹5,000 crore Bhogapuram Airport in Andhra Pradesh; lays foundation stone for other projects
item.description: The Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport in Bhogapuram has been developed under the Public-Private Partnership (PPP) mode at a cost of over ₹5,640 crore, according to a government statement.

item.title: CJP's Abhijeet Dipke falls sick, vomits at public gathering days after revealing typhoid diagnosis
item.description: CJP leader Abhijeet Dipke felt unwell while meeting people at his residence in Maharashtra. He appeared uneasy and even vomited. This incident follows his recent typhoid diagnosis.

item.title: Russia Hits Kyiv With ‘Horrific’ Missile Barrage, Killing Nine
item.description: Russia launched a barrage of ballistic missiles and attack drones against Ukraine’s capital overnight, killing nine people and injuring at least 30, as Ukrainian officials urged the supply of more anti-missile weapons from allies.

item.title: Cloudburst in J&K's Kishtwar triggers flash flood, shops damaged, schools shut across Chenab Valley: What we know so far
item.description: A cloudburst hit the Chatroo area in Jammu and Kashmir's Kishtwar district in the early hours of Saturday, triggering flash floods, and forcing several schools to shut down for the day.

item.title: Who is Nirmal Purja? Celebrated mountaineer remains missing after Pakistan's Broad Peak avalanche
item.description: Nepalese climber Nirmal Purja, a record-holding mountaineer, went missing after an avalanche on Broad Peak with nine others. Known for his achievements in high-altitude climbing, he was part of Pakistan's Broad Peak expedition.
